initial_audit.purpose: Confirm the new cell evidence raw command-log digests and matching actual job stdout on completed macOS ARM cells before the combined artifact exists.
initial_audit.script:
import io,json,hashlib,zipfile,re
from urllib.request import urlopen
compile(configuration["auditor"],"<grouped-packaging-audit>","exec")
with urlopen(configuration["download_url"],timeout=45) as response:
    raw=response.read()
assert len(raw)==configuration["artifact"]["size_in_bytes"]
assert "sha256:"+hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==configuration["artifact"]["digest"]
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as z:
    files={name:z.read(name) for name in z.namelist() if not name.endswith("/")}
log=re.sub(r"(?m)^\ufeff?\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\d\d:\d\d:\d\d(?:\.\d+)?Z ","",configuration["job_log"].replace("\r\n","\n"))
result=[]
for minor in range(10,16):
    prefix=f"cp3{minor}/"
    report=json.loads(files[prefix+"validation.json"])
    assert report["status"]=="passed" and report["expected_python"]==f"3.{minor}"
    assert report["target"]=="macos_arm64" and report["run_id"]=="43897981051" and report["run_attempt"]=="1"
    assert report["source"]["commit"]=="ba1bcef8d4fcf325a3403c2ff9c540312c491464"
    for command in report["commands"]:
        value=files[prefix+command["log"]]
        assert command["returncode"]==0
        assert command["log_bytes"]==len(value)
        assert command["log_sha256"]==hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest()
        plain=value.decode().replace("\r\n","\n").strip("\n")
        assert not plain or plain in log
    tests=files[prefix+"test.log"].decode()
    assert len(re.findall(r"^Ran 144 tests in ",tests,re.M))==1
    assert re.search(r"^OK \(skipped=2\)$",tests,re.M)
    result.append({"minor":report["expected_python"],"status":report["status"],"interpreter":report["interpreter"],"tests":report["tests"],"commands":len(report["commands"]),"build_log":report["build_log"],"validation_sha256":hashlib.sha256(files[prefix+"validation.json"]).hexdigest()})
print("PRELIMINARY_JSON="+json.dumps({"artifact_id":configuration["artifact"]["id"],"artifact_sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"files":len(files),"cells":result,"auditor_syntax":"passed"}),flush=True)
